limits: Completion is solver-guided reachability through real UI inputs, based on read-only state snapshots injected only in tests.
Ordinary-input checks cover explicit invalid actions, keyboard focus and restart; they do not establish human difficulty or independent solve quality.
Mobile-touch uses Chromium touch emulation. No physical phone or actual screenreader test.
Three studies per game; random instances may admit multiple valid solutions. No claim of exhaustive play-space testing.
